vars.description: List of environment variables to set via PAM. Each item defines a variable name, optional default value, and optional condition.

name.description: Name of the environment variable to set (e.g., LANG, TZ, PATH).

default.description: Default value to assign if no value is provided elsewhere (e.g., 'en_US.UTF-8', '/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin').

condition.description: Optional condition (PAM argument string) controlling when this assignment applies (e.g., 'DEFAULT=foo USER=root', 'DEFAULT=bar CONSOLE=true'). See pam_env(8) for supported conditions.
